job.title: Quality Inspector
job.description:
Quality Inspector
Location: Kalamazoo MI 49002 Shift: 3rd Shift, Monday–Friday, 11 PM to 7 AM Pay: $15.00 per hour
Job Summary
Are you detail-oriented and committed to accuracy? We’re seeking a Quality Inspector to join our team in Kalamazoo, MI. In this role, you’ll play a key part in ensuring products meet quality standards before they reach customers. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on inspection work, follows procedures closely, and takes pride in maintaining high-quality results in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
What You’ll Be Doing
As a Quality Inspector, your core responsibilities will include:

Using measurement tools: Work with calipers, micrometers, gauges, and other inspection equipment to verify product accuracy. ? Documenting results: Record inspection findings, complete quality reports, and communicate issues to supervisors or production leads. ? Identifying defects: Detect nonconforming parts, tag or quarantine defective items, and assist with root-cause information when needed. ? Supporting production: Work closely with machine operators and assemblers to maintain consistent quality throughout the manufacturing process. ? Maintaining a clean and safe work area: Follow all safety procedures, handle materials properly, and support general housekeeping tasks.
In addition, you may assist with incoming material checks, final inspections, rework verification, and other quality-related tasks as needed.
What We’re Looking For
Qualifications:
? Previous experience in quality inspection, manufacturing, or assembly preferred but not required. ? Ability to read and understand basic work instructions, diagrams, or blueprints.
? Ability to use basic measurement tools (calipers, gauges, rulers, etc.).
? Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
? Ability to stand for long periods and lift up to 40 lbs.
? Dependable attendance and a strong work ethic.
? Willingness to work in a fast-paced, manufacturing environment.
Skills:
? Attention to Detail: Critical for identifying defects and ensuring product consistency.
? Communication: Ability to clearly report issues and collaborate with production teams. ? Problem-Solving: Helps identify quality concerns and support corrective actions.
? Basic Mechanical Aptitude: Useful for understanding how parts fit, function, and meet specifications.

This is an excellent opportunity for both short-term and long-term employment. We are committed to providing a supportive work environment and opportunities for growth within quality, production, and manufacturing operations.

job.description:
Quality Technician
Location: Three Rivers Shift: 1st shift Mon-Thursday 6am-4pm Pay: $20.00 per hour
Job Summary
Are you detail-oriented and committed to accuracy? We’re seeking a Quality Technician to join our team in Three Rivers, MI. In this role, you’ll play a key part in ensuring products meet quality standards before they reach customers. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on inspection work, follows procedures closely, and takes pride in maintaining high-quality results in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

As a Quality Technician, your core responsibilities will include:

Using measurement tools: Work with calipers, micrometers, gauges, and other inspection equipment to verify product accuracy. ? Documenting results: Record inspection findings, complete quality reports, and communicate issues to supervisors or production leads. ? Identifying defects: Detect nonconforming parts, tag or quarantine defective items, and assist with root-cause information when needed. ? Supporting production: Work closely with machine operators and assemblers to maintain consistent quality throughout the manufacturing process. ? Maintaining a clean and safe work area: Follow all safety procedures, handle materials properly, and support general housekeeping tasks.
In addition, you may assist with incoming material checks, final inspections, rework verification, and other quality-related tasks as needed.

? Previous experience in quality inspection, manufacturing, or assembly preferred but not required. ? Ability to read and understand basic work instructions, diagrams, or blueprints.
? Ability to use basic measurement tools (calipers, gauges, rulers, etc.). ? Quality Tools, PPAP, APQP, MSA, PFMEA
? Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
? Ability to stand for long periods and lift up to 40 lbs. ? ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System
? Dependable attendance and a strong work ethic.
? Willingness to work in a fast-paced, manufacturing environment.
Skills:
? Attention to Detail: Critical for identifying defects and ensuring product consistency.
? Communication: Ability to clearly report issues and collaborate with production teams. ? Problem-Solving: Helps identify quality concerns and support corrective actions.
? Basic Mechanical Aptitude: Useful for understanding how parts fit, function, and meet specifications.

This is an excellent opportunity for both short-term and long-term employment. We are committed to providing a supportive work environment and opportunities for growth within quality, production, and manufacturing operations.

job.description:

We're looking for a skilled MIG Welder to join our manufacturing team in Holland, MI. In this role, you'll perform MIG welding on outdoor patio tables and chairs, helping fabricate and assemble quality finished products. The ideal candidate has previous MIG welding experience, is comfortable working in a metal fabrication environment, and takes pride in producing clean, consistent welds. What You'll Be Doing As a MIG Welder, your core responsibilities will include: MIG Welding: Perform MIG welding on components used to manufacture outdoor patio tables and chairs. Product Assembly: Fit, position, and weld components together to produce completed patio furniture. Steel Fabrication: Assist with the fabrication and assembly of steel components used throughout the manufacturing process. Fit-Up: Properly position and align parts prior to welding to ensure accurate assembly. Quality Inspection: Inspect completed welds and fabricated components to ensure they meet quality standards. job.description: Press Operator Location: Wixom Shift: 6:30am-3PM Pay: $18 Job Summary Workbox Staffing is seeking a Die Cut Machine Operator to operate die cutting equipment and produce quality components according to established production processes and customer specifications. The ideal candidate is mechanically inclined, detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. What You’ll Be Doing Operate die cutting equipment to produce die cut components according to documented processes and specifications. Maintain 100% compliance with equipment-related production systems, processes, and safety requirements. Set up jobs according to documented setup procedures and maintain production samples for traceability. Perform part inspections to ensure required quality standards and metrics are met. Support efficient production start-ups, shutdowns, and changeovers. Follow Lean Manufacturing principles and participate in scheduled Kaizen events and continuous improvement activities. Identify and report quality issues or nonconforming products to the Quality team. Help contain potentially nonconforming product and complete required documentation. Perform daily press maintenance as assigned and report mechanical issues to the Production Supervisor. Record completed equipment maintenance in the appropriate press maintenance log. Clean and maintain tooling according to manufacturer recommendations. Complete required documentation for tooling repairs and report damaged tooling. Maintain a clean, organized, and efficient workspace, including press surfaces, materials, and carts. Follow documented press practices, warning labels, and other safety procedures. Work with team members to resolve problems and recommend improvements to products and processes. Complete required production, quality, and performance documentation. Attend work and return from breaks according to scheduled shift times. Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor. What We’re Looking For Previous manufacturing or machine operation experience preferred. Experience operating die cutting equipment strongly preferred. Good mechanical aptitude. Basic math skills. Ability to follow documented processes and work instructions. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Ability to work quickly while maintaining accuracy. Computer proficiency, including basic Microsoft Word and Excel skills. Experience with ERP or production reporting systems preferred. Knowledge of ISO 9001 and/or IATF/TS 16949 standards is a plus. Understanding of Lean Manufacturing principles is preferred. Strong teamwork and accountability. Qualifications Ability to lift and move 30+ pounds repeatedly throughout the workday. Ability to stand and remain active throughout the shift. Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Ability to safely operate production equipment after proper training. Ability to follow all company safety, quality, and production requirements. job.title: 1st Shift - CNC Operator
job.description:
Job Title: CNC Machinist/Operator Location: American Fabricated Products Company Overview: American Fab is a leading manufacturing company specializing in Prime and Sub-Prime Defense Contractors, Automotive & Furniture OEMs and their sub-tiers as well as many other Industrial markets. We are dedicated to delivering high-quality precision components to our clients while maintaining efficient production processes. As we continue to expand, we are seeking a skilled CNC Operator to join our team and contribute to our success. Position Overview: We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced CNC Operator to set up, operate, and maintain our computer numerical control (CNC) machines. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of CNC programming, machining techniques, and a commitment to producing quality products within specified deadlines. The CNC Operator will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of our manufacturing processes. Responsibilities: Set up and operate CNC machines according to specifications, blueprints, and job routers. Load raw materials into the machine and secure them properly. Monitor machine operations to ensure quality and adjust machine settings as needed. Interpret CNC programs and make necessary adjustments to optimize production. Conduct routine maintenance on machines to ensure they are in good working condition. Inspect finished products for quality and accuracy, making any necessary adjustments. Troubleshoot issues with machines and perform minor repairs as needed. Adhere to safety protocols and maintain a clean and organized work area. Collaborate with other team members to achieve production goals and meet deadlines. Document production activities and maintain records of machine settings and adjustments. Qualifications: High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification or degree in machining or related field preferred. Proven experience as a CNC Operator or similar role in a manufacturing environment. Strong understanding of CNC programming, machining techniques, and tooling. Proficiency in reading blueprints, schematics, and technical drawings. Ability to use precision measuring tools, such as calipers and micrometers. Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills and the ability to follow instructions accurately. Knowledge of safety procedures and protocols for operating machinery. Flexibility to work various shifts and overtime as needed. CNC Operator - 1st Shift Location: Spring Lake, MI
Job SummaryAre you an experienced CNC Operator looking for an opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced manufacturing environment? We’re seeking a dependable and detail-oriented individual to join our team in Spring Lake, MI. In this role, you’ll play a key part in producing high-quality machined parts while ensuring efficiency and accuracy throughout the process.
What You'll Be DoingAs a CNC Operator, your core responsibilities will include: Operating CNC machines to produce parts according to specifications Making adjustments to machine settings to maintain quality and efficiency Inspecting finished parts using measuring tools such as calipers and micrometers In addition, you will also be expected to troubleshoot minor machine issues and maintain a clean and safe work environment.
What We're Looking For Qualifications: High school diploma or equivalent preferred Previous CNC operating experience required Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and stand for extended periods
Skills: Ability to read and interpret blueprints and measurements Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills Mechanical aptitude and ability to make machine adjustments
Why Join Us?This is an excellent opportunity for both short-term and long-term employment. We are committed to providing a supportive work environment and opportunities for growth.

job.description:
Powder Coater
Location: Rothbury, MI Pay: $16+ per hour
Job Summary
Are you dependable, detail-oriented, and interested in building your manufacturing skills? We’re seeking a Powder Coater to join our team in Rothbury, MI. In this role, you’ll prepare parts, apply powder coating, and help ensure finished products meet quality standards. Previous powder coating experience is preferred, but we are willing to train someone who is motivated to learn.
What You’ll Be Doing
As a Powder Coater, your core responsibilities will include:
• Preparing and cleaning parts before coating • Applying powder coating evenly according to specifications • Hanging and removing parts from the coating line • Inspecting finished parts for proper coverage and quality • Completing touch-ups or rework when needed • Following production instructions and safety procedures
In addition, you will be expected to maintain a clean and organized work area and assist with other production duties as needed.
What We’re Looking For
To be successful in this role, you should have the following:
Qualifications
• Previous powder coating or industrial painting experience is preferred • Willingness to learn powder coating equipment and processes • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions • Ability to stand for extended periods and perform repetitive tasks • Reliable attendance and a strong work ethic
Skills
• Strong attention to detail • Ability to identify coating and finish defects • Basic mechanical aptitude • Ability to work efficiently in a production environment • Commitment to workplace safety

job.description: Press Operator Location: Wixom Shift: 6:30am-3PM Pay: $18 Job Summary Workbox Staffing is seeking a Die Cut Machine Operator to operate die cutting equipment and produce quality components according to established production processes and customer specifications. The ideal candidate is mechanically inclined, detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. What You’ll Be Doing Operate die cutting equipment to produce die cut components according to documented processes and specifications. Maintain 100% compliance with equipment-related production systems, processes, and safety requirements. Set up jobs according to documented setup procedures and maintain production samples for traceability. Perform part inspections to ensure required quality standards and metrics are met. Support efficient production start-ups, shutdowns, and changeovers. Follow Lean Manufacturing principles and participate in scheduled Kaizen events and continuous improvement activities. Identify and report quality issues or nonconforming products to the Quality team. Help contain potentially nonconforming product and complete required documentation. Perform daily press maintenance as assigned and report mechanical issues to the Production Supervisor. Record completed equipment maintenance in the appropriate press maintenance log. Clean and maintain tooling according to manufacturer recommendations. Complete required documentation for tooling repairs and report damaged tooling. Maintain a clean, organized, and efficient workspace, including press surfaces, materials, and carts. Follow documented press practices, warning labels, and other safety procedures. Work with team members to resolve problems and recommend improvements to products and processes. Complete required production, quality, and performance documentation. job.description:
JOB TITLE DEPARTMENT CREATED
Quality Engineer Quality 02/21/24
POSITION DESCRIPTION
Support position with primary activities being the development and management of facility Advanced Product Quality Planning and PPAP process.
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
Develop and implement the customer and internal requirements of process manuals and quality standards f.or takeover tooling, including updates/changes resulting from engineering changes. Work closely with the Quality Technician in the development of the decision making documents to be used i.n the manufacturing process. Lead the development process of the Process FMEA’s. Initiate customer or internal, sample submission activities for transfer tool program. Manage Product drawings from receipt to file location/current revision. Coordinate the development of information supporting sample submission activities, such as: G. age R&R studies; Dimensional Layout(s); Capability Studies; Laboratory Material Testing; Performance Testing; Fit and function. Obtain and verify compliance of submitted documentation of internal process/inspection plans, measurement results and capability studies.
ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES
Maintain and apply Corrective Action process, as required. Offer support and guidance as needed to the Quality Technician to manage and administer measurement .equipment calibration activities as required. Manage annual customer product revalidations as required. Obtain and verify submission documentation from suppliers, as required. Support customer requirements - customer visits. Assist in development, organization, and maintenance of the quality reporting system. This includes, but is not limited to the following: Internal scrap to include ppm reporting activities and associated top contributor b. readksowns on an effective basis; Customer product rejections to include daily ppm reporting activities and a. ssocated top contributor breakdowns on an effective basis. Coordinate the development of information supporting production part approval submission activities, such as: D. imensional layouts; Capability studies. OTHER REQUIREMENTS
Associates degree from a college or university or a minimum of two years quality engineering experience or a. n equivalent combination of education and experience. Proficient in personal computer use and network operation. Ability to read, interpret documents, communicated effectively across all levels, and present information t.o various group. Ability at math, percentages, proportions, and basic statistics. Ability to manage problem-solving activities. Ability to apply logic to follow written, oral, or diagram instructions. Completion of training requirements matrix.
POSITION KEY INTERFACES
INTERNAL EXTERNAL
All Clarion’s associates at a single location Customers Clarion Corporate program support Suppliers
KEY MEASURE ACCOUNTABILITY
Teamwork/interpersonal skills Judgement/Decision making Attention to detail and accuracy of work Communication Skills

(optional, depends on local legal requirements)
EMPLOYEE NAME DATE EMPLOYEE SIGNATURE
Quality Engineer
Location: Greenville, MI Pay: 60k-75k depending on experience Shift: 1st shift
Job Summary The Quality Engineer is responsible for supporting the development and management of the facility’s Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP). This position works closely with Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, suppliers, and customers to ensure quality requirements are met throughout the product and tooling process.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities Develop and implement customer and internal requirements for process manuals and quality standards related to takeover tooling. Maintain and update quality documentation as engineering changes occur. Work closely with the Quality Technician to develop decision-making documents used in the manufacturing process. Lead the development of Process Failure Mode and Effects Analyses (PFMEAs). Initiate and coordinate customer and internal sample submission activities for transfer tooling programs. Manage product drawings from receipt through proper filing and revision control. Coordinate documentation and activities supporting sample submissions, including:Gage R&R studies Dimensional layouts Capability studies Laboratory material testing Performance testing Fit and function testing Obtain and verify internal process and inspection plans, measurement results, capability studies, and other required documentation. Maintain and apply the corrective action process as needed. Support and provide guidance to the Quality Technician with measurement equipment calibration activities. Manage annual customer product revalidations. Obtain and verify required quality documentation from suppliers. Support customer requirements and customer visits. Assist with the development, organization, and maintenance of the quality reporting system. Monitor and report internal scrap, including PPM reporting and analysis of top contributors. Monitor and report customer product rejections, including daily PPM reporting and analysis of top contributors. Coordinate the development of information required for production part approval submissions, including dimensional layouts and capability studies. Qualifications & Requirements Associate degree from a college or university or a minimum of two years of Quality Engineering experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Proficient in personal computer use and network operations. Ability to read and interpret documents and communicate effectively with employees at all levels. Ability to present information to various groups. Strong understanding of mathematics, percentages, proportions, and basic statistics. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Ability to apply logic and follow written, verbal, and diagram instructions. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good teamwork and interpersonal skills. Ability to complete required training programs. Key Skills APQP & PPAP PFMEA Corrective Action Quality Documentation Capability Studies Gage R&R Dimensional Layouts Quality Reporting Problem Solving Data Analysis Communication & Teamwork Why Join Us? We’re committed to providing a supportive work environment, opportunities for growth, and a team that cares.Workbox Staffing Benefits

We're seeking a Warehouse Associate to join our team in Jackson, MI. job.title: Machine Operator III
job.description: Machine Operator III – 3rd Shift Location: Holland, MI Shift: 3rd Shift | 8:30 PM–7:00 AM | Sunday–Thursday Pay: $19.00–$21.00/hour Job Summary We're looking for an experienced and mechanically inclined Machine Operator III to join our 3rd Shift production team in Holland, MI. In this role, you'll set up, adjust, and safely operate a variety of machines used to cut and slot partitions from different types of roll stock according to specifications. This position requires strong machine setup and troubleshooting skills, attention to product quality, and the ability to recognize and correct operating issues independently. What You'll Be Doing As a Machine Operator III, your core responsibilities will include: Machine Setup & Operation: Set up, adjust, and safely operate machines used to cut and slot partitions according to production specifications. Equipment Adjustments: Work from patterns to mount and adjust dies, guides, feeds, speeds, tension, and other machine settings. Troubleshooting: Recognize operating problems and make necessary adjustments for stock variations, worn dies, humidity, and other production conditions. Quality Control: Take responsibility for product quality and use board gauges, rules, patterns, and other inspection tools to verify specifications. Material Handling: Move and change rolls, transport strip loads and scrap loads, and safely operate hand and power trucks. Machine Maintenance: Perform routine machine repairs, lubrication, and preventive maintenance as needed. Production Documentation: Accurately record and report production times, materials produced, equipment problems, and other required information. Production Scheduling: Work from manufacturing requirement schedules to complete assigned production work efficiently. Training & Cross-Training: Train other team members, answer questions regarding stacking and packing procedures, and participate in cross-training. Parts & Supplies: Maintain a working knowledge of material and inventory identification and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Safety: Practice and promote safe work habits while immediately reporting unsafe conditions or equipment requiring repair. In addition, you'll maintain expected productivity levels, communicate effectively with team members and leadership, and help create a positive, team-based production environment. job.description:

We're seeking a Production Operator to join our team in Clare, MI. In this role, you'll be a vital part of our operations, helping us to ensure quality production through robotic welding and CNC machine operation. What You'll Be Doing As a Production Operator, your core responsibilities will include: Inspecting Incoming Material: Ensuring quality specifications and quantities are met. Operating an Overhead Crane: Receiving and issuing raw material to and from saws, trucks, and storage areas. Robotic Welding and CNC Machine Operation: Programming, setting up, operating, and adjusting process variables to meet quality demands. In addition, you will also be expected to maintain inventory control, complete entry of work orders and packing slips, and perform daily shift maintenance inspections. Not only will you be responsible for inspecting and managing raw materials and operating an overhead crane, but you’ll also be primarily focused on robotic welding and operating other CNC machines, including programming, setup, and adjustment to ensure quality products. What We're Looking For To be successful in this role, you should have the following: Qualifications:High school diploma or equivalent desired. Two years of experience and/or educational related courses on related machinery desired. Experience/knowledge of blueprint reading, AutoCAD, CNC programming, thermal cutting machinery, and welding knowledge preferred. Ability to obtain a Crane License and fork truck license. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret the English language. Satisfactory math skills including addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and basic geometry. Excellent problem-solving abilities. Ability to multi-task. Ability to operate machinery on a three-dimensional basis. Agility of the upper and lower body extremities, and capable of lifting 50 pounds regularly. Skills:Quality Inspection: To inspect incoming material for quality specification and quantities. Material Handling: To receive and issue raw material to and from saws, trucks, and storage areas by operation of an overhead crane. Robotic Welding and CNC Operation: Primary focus would be working on the robotic welder and fabrication of products utilizing other CNC machines, including programming, machine setup, operation, and adjustment of process variables to meet quality demands. Inventory Control: To maintain inventory control by identifying and labeling raw material with proper identification. Computer System Entry: To complete entry of work orders, packing slips, etc., into the main computer system. Welding Knowledge: Must be knowledgeable in welding. Work Order Processing: To receive and issue raw material according to the work order, prints, routings, and bill of lading. Program Selection: To select appropriate programs utilizing the operating software, based upon the work order and print. Verification: Cross-checking that revision, part number, and description are correct. Before loading material into the machine, verify correct amount, size, gauge, and length of material has been loaded into the machine and issued to the work order. Measurement: Utilizing calipers, micrometers, and other measuring devices to verify accuracy. Quality Assurance: To check the quality of the first part for appearance and that the part meets print specifications. Assures that the fit, function, and appearance of products are at, or exceed quality standards. Production Fulfillment: Fulfills production requirements. Part Placement: To place finished parts in proper container/rack and designated location. Record Keeping: To record on work order all labor and downtime, documenting all information pertaining to each work order and routing. Maintenance: Performs daily shift maintenance inspection per the preventative maintenance (PM) checklist. Collaboration: Confers with the Team Leader or Crew Leader on any problems regarding safety, quality, production, inventory issues, etc. Confers with Engineering Programmer to maximize potential efficiency and quality gains in the manufacturing process. Work Area Maintenance: Maintain high quality standards as regards to machine and work area. Removal of all metal scrap, debris, and residue from machine as needed. Why Join Us? job.title: 1st Shift- Inspector Packer - Finishing Dept
job.description:
Job Description
Inspector Packer
Job Code Job Category 600 8 Laborers and Helpers
Employment
Position Overview
Job Description:
Operates a bagger machine that converts flexible packaging by performing the following duties;
• Starts machine and observes operation to detect malfunctions of machine.
• Makes minor adjustments or repairs such as adjust wicket pins forward and alter, eye adjustment for print cut off, vent position forward and after, and wicket holes forward and after.
• Inspects filled cartons to ensure that product is packaged according to specifications.
• Checks for quality characteristics and specifications as shown in training
• Replenishes packing supplies such as wickets, chipboard, labels and boxes by requesting them from the set up mechanics
• Shut off machine and report critical defects to set up mechanic and / or quality auditor such as open or weak seals, missing safety slits, vents not punching, blocked film, bad print, wicket holes not punching, large wrinkles and folding edges. • Attempt to correct slight specification variances such as vent position and slightly uneven safety slits while keeping the machine running.
• Be aware of customer specific quality issues as noted on specification sheets.
• Keep the supply table and work area neat and clean by using set up time to sweep and vacuum "dots", make boxes or organize supplies.
• Pack cartons neatly. Place labels on the box after it is filled to specification and taped. Number each label with skid and carton number.
• All paperwork should be neat, complete and accurate before leaving for the day. This refers to green sheets, carton tally sheet and daily production reports.
• Leave area with supplies necessary for the next shift. Take unused materials back to the warehouse at the end of each job when possible.
• Check presets at the beginning of your shift and with each new job.
• When a job order is complete the operator should double check that all production related paperwork is complete, place old supplies by unwind of machine and clean machine and immediate area. Afterwards they should become familiar with the next job by reading paperwork and getting new supplies in place.
• Follow all safety and company policies.
• Maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving and communicating in a manner so that you get along with clients, customers, vendors, co-workers and supervisors. • Any and all other duties as assigned by the manager and/or designee.
Essential Functions No Details
Work Experience Required Experience: Not Specified
Job Requirement:
EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE
Less than high school education; or up to one month related experience or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
· Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
· Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos
· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.
· Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs. High level of measuring ability.
· Ability to apply common sense and understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
· Strong verbal and written English communication skills. · A drive to succeed with a self-starter approach and a can-do attitude.
Physical Demands and Work Environment
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand and use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee frequently is required to walk and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 40 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, and color vision.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.
Packaging Personified, Inc. is a manufacturer of food grade packaging. All employees are responsible for following a Safe Quality Food practices and policies.
Packaging Personified is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.
Education Required Degree Level: Not Specified No Details

This is the most critical skill for success in this position. -Precision Measurement: Ability to verify dimensional accuracy using measuring tools such as steel rulers and digital calipers. -Dependability & Professionalism: Demonstrates integrity, maintains a positive attitude, communicates openly with teammates, works well under pressure, and consistently completes work accurately and on time.
Why Join Us? This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing manufacturing team where your work directly impacts the success of the entire operation. As the Waterjet Operator, you'll manage the flow of materials that supports the company's finished goods production, making this one of the most important positions on the production floor. Job Summary Are you a detail-oriented individual who takes pride in producing quality work? We're seeking a Final Inspector to join our team in Bremen, IN. In this role, you'll play a critical part in our quality assurance process by performing final inspections on precision roller bearings before they are packaged and shipped. Your attention to detail will help ensure every product meets our high standards for quality and customer satisfaction. What You'll Be Doing As a Final Inspector, your core responsibilities will include: Performing final product inspections: Conduct thorough visual inspections of finished roller bearings to identify defects and verify products meet quality standards. Handling materials safely and efficiently: Load bearings onto inspection tables using a barrel dumper or by hand, then move inspected products to the packing department. Maintaining quality documentation: Follow inspection procedures, complete required paperwork accurately, and ensure all product handling instructions are followed. In addition, you will also be expected to maintain a clean work area, communicate quality concerns to supervisors, and support production goals while maintaining strict quality standards. Attention to Detail: Strong focus on accuracy while inspecting parts and completing documentation. Dependability: Reliable attendance and the ability to follow standardized work instructions consistently. Why Join Us? This is an excellent opportunity to begin a long-term career with a company that values quality, precision, and teamwork. You'll receive hands-on training on 1st Shift before transitioning to your permanent 2nd Shift schedule with an automatic pay increase upon successful completion of training. job.title: 1st Shift - Quality Inspector
job.description: Quality Inspector Location: Dexter, MI Shift: 1st (6am-3:30pm) M-F Pay: $20/hr Job Summary Are you a motivated and detail-oriented individual looking for a new opportunity? We're seeking a Quality Inspector to join our team in Dexter, MI. In this role, you'll be a vital part of our manufacturing operations, helping ensure products meet customer specifications and quality standards through accurate inspections, documentation, and attention to detail. What You'll Be Doing As a Quality Inspector, your core responsibilities will include: Performing in-process inspections: Complete visual inspections, dimensional checks, and functional testing throughout the manufacturing process to ensure parts meet established specifications. Using precision measuring equipment: Utilize tools such as calipers, micrometers, depth micrometers, pin gauges, thread gauges, comparators, indicators, and other inspection equipment to verify part accuracy. Reviewing specifications and documentation: Read and interpret blueprints, Quality Control Instructions, and GD&T requirements to identify defects and confirm products meet quality standards. In addition, you will also be expected to complete quality documentation, perform process audits, assist with sorting and rework activities, maintain compliance with quality procedures, and communicate inspection findings clearly with the production team. What We're Looking For To be successful in this role, you should have the following: Qualifications: 1–2+ years of experience in manufacturing quality inspection or a related production quality role required. Experience using precision measuring tools such as calipers, micrometers, gauges, or similar inspection equipment. Ability to read and understand blueprints, work instructions, and quality documentation. Ability to work independently, maintain strong attendance, and support overtime needs as required. Basic computer skills and ability to accurately document inspection results. Skills: Strong attention to detail: Ability to identify quality issues, recognize defects, and ensure parts meet customer expectations. Problem-solving skills: Ability to investigate quality concerns, communicate findings, and support corrective actions. Mechanical aptitude: Comfortable working with manufacturing processes, inspection tools, and production equipment. Organization and communication: Ability to maintain accurate records and effectively communicate quality findings with team members. Why Join Us? This is an excellent opportunity for both short-term and long-term employment. We are committed to providing a supportive work environment and opportunities for growth.
